name: Franchise Evaluation
description: Guided workflow for evaluating and launching a franchise business from initial research and self-assessment through Franchise Disclosure Document analysis, financing, location selection, and operational launch. Covers the complete franchise investigation process for first-time franchisees. Use when the user wants to franchise evaluation or needs a structured multi-step process for this goal. Do NOT use when the request is a single-step task or requires professional advice beyond educational guidance.
